strings.en:
{1c:1b}{0b:08}【 Scholarly Man 】{0b:09}
My name is Qumran, and I study the
underground ruins here.{1a}I would have liked to begin with the
history of the 'Sun Empire', but most of
you care only for treasure, so that can
wait for another day.{1a}Instead, let me pass on a few useful
facts.{1a}{0c:520fff08}First, the passage of time inside the
ruins differs completely from one level
to another.{1a}Inside you may feel you have stayed an
hour and find only a minute has passed,
or that ten days have.{1a}{0c:52ff09ff0a}Some of you may not have much time to
spare.{1a}If you have little time left to achieve
your goal, you should avoid lingering
where time flows quickly.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: My name is Qumran, and I study the underground ruins here. // I would have liked to begin with the history of the 'Sun Empire', but most of you care only for treasure, so that can wait for another day. // Instead, let me pass on a few useful facts. // [1]First, the passage of time inside the ruins differs completely from one level to another. // Inside you may feel you have stayed an hour and find only a minute has passed, or that ten days have. // [2]Some of you may not have much time to spare. // If you have little time left to achieve your goal, you should avoid lingering where time flows quickly.
